command_line:
set +e
status=0
python3 -m pip install --target .deps 'caper==2.2.2' > pip.log 2>&1
install_status=$$?
PYTHONPATH=.deps:/software/atac-seq-pipeline/src .deps/bin/caper --help > caper_help.txt 2>&1
caper_help_status=$$?
PYTHONPATH=.deps:/software/atac-seq-pipeline/src .deps/bin/caper run --help > caper_run_help.txt 2>&1
caper_run_help_status=$$?
{
  echo '--- statuses ---'
  echo "install_status=$$install_status"
  echo "caper_help_status=$$caper_help_status"
  echo "caper_run_help_status=$$caper_run_help_status"
  echo '--- files ---'
  find .deps -maxdepth 2 -type f | sort | head -80
  echo '--- pip ---'
  sed -n '1,180p' pip.log
  echo '--- caper help ---'
  sed -n '1,180p' caper_help.txt
  echo '--- caper run help ---'
  sed -n '1,240p' caper_run_help.txt
} > caper_probe.txt
exit 0
